summary: Regression re-verified after main-agent fix to student_chat_attachment_matches magic-byte signatures and audio compress_image bypass. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_student_live_chat_audio.py runs 6/6 green (webm/ogg/mp3 accepted, .exe rejected, admin download works, cleanup empty). Frontend mobile 390x844: paperclip (x=33, w=44) and mic (x=89, w=44) render side-by-side at same y (800), no horizontal overflow. Press-hold triggers student-chat-recording-status with correct copy 'Merekam — lepas untuk kirim atau geser ke atas untuk kunci'; release POSTs .webm and audios grow 3->4. Locked flow (swipe-up + explicit click) also succeeds (4->5). Admin Provinsi logs in, opens Live Chat > Pesan Mahasiswa > Cheng Suya, sees 5 audio elements; GET /api/student-live-chat/attachments/<id> returns 200 with content-type=audio/webm.
critical_code_review_comments: Consider centralising the audio extension list -> magic-byte map so future audio codecs only touch one dict (matches() + STUDENT_CHAT_ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS + error copy).
Error copy 'Gunakan JPG, PNG, WEBP, atau PDF.' still fails to mention audio formats even though they are whitelisted - low priority UX polish.
StudentLiveChat.jsx lacks graceful fallback when window.MediaRecorder is undefined (older iOS Safari <14.5); mic button will simply do nothing. Suggest disabling with tooltip.
Backend never verifies audio duration or transcodes; up-to-10MB webm stored as-is. Acceptable for MVP.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (layout + press-hold + locked flow + admin playback all pass)

seed_data_creation: None persistent. Test file creates ephemeral TEST_slc_audio messages and removes them in test_zzz_cleanup. Frontend E2E left ~2 short webm blobs in Cheng Suya's conversation; these are user-generated (not TEST_ prefixed) and can be removed by main agent if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 55 confirmed the audio voice-note feature works end-to-end. Reusable test file at /app/backend/tests/test_student_live_chat_audio.py. Mobile UI selectors: student-chat-record-button, student-chat-recording-status, student-chat-audio-<id>. Admin path: sidebar Live Chat -> tab 'Pesan Mahasiswa' -> click admin-student-chat-conversation-<student_id>. GET /api/student-live-chat/attachments/<id>?auth=<jwt> returns audio/webm 200. Login page uses data-testid=login-email-input / login-password-input; role=button name='Masuk'. Dashboard hamburger uses data-testid=sidebar-toggle and menu items use data-testid=mobile-menu-<id> where <id>=live-chat-admin.
rca of the issue: Iter 54 root cause: student_chat_attachment_matches() dict lacked webm/ogg/mp3/wav/m4a entries, and MIME_TYPES[extension] was evaluated as default of dict.get() even when the key existed - causing audio uploads to also enter compress_image. Main agent added magic-byte signatures (EBML for webm, OggS for ogg, ID3/frame-sync for mp3, RIFF/WAVE for wav, ftyp for m4a), fixed the eager-default MIME evaluation to a proper conditional lookup, and bypassed compress_image for audio content-types. All prior failing assertions now pass and browser flow succeeds.
